end.summary:
Practised speed as distance ÷ time using 200 m in 10 s = 20 m/s.
Distinguished speed as a number from velocity, which includes direction.
Used the convention right = positive and left = negative.
Applied the convention to a leftward velocity of −20 m/s.
Acceleration was not practised; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised speed calculations and the difference between speed and velocity. Diya correctly used the method distance ÷ time and repeatedly identified left as negative and right as positive; the main difficulty was that the requested cheetah image and number-line arrows did not appear on screen, so no visual correction was completed later in the lesson. At home, draw a number line with right as positive and left as negative, then label a leftward velocity of −20 m/s.
